title: Advances in conducting nanocomposite hydrogels for wearable biomonitoring
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00220B, Review Article
Arpita Roy, Ronak Afshari, Saumya Jain, Yuting Zheng, Min-Hsuan Lin, Shea Zenkar, Junyi Yin, Jun Chen, Nicholas A. Peppas, Nasim Annabi
